answer: Make the cost per fake identity grow faster than its value, and keep it non-transferable. Tie each identity to a unique proof-of-work bound to its key, like a crystal that only fits one lock, so one solve cannot be reused across a fleet. Reputation rides only on non-kin, cross-checked attestations of real work, never bought — a pearl of earned trust. Cluster clones reveal themselves as a shared behavioral ridge and collapse to one entity, while honest standing builds only through labor. A farm pays per-identity compute and cannot pool it, so its cost scales with size.
